recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Moonlit Meme Wand**, a portrait-first browser rhythm game. Preserve a four-lane perspective timing mechanic: notes spawn on beats, travel from a top vanishing point toward bottom hit pads, and are judged by tapping the lane under the player’s thumb. Keep perfect/great/miss windows, combo scoring, energy recovery/loss, and game-over-on-energy-depletion semantics intact.

Present the game as a satirical moon-magical meme ritual: a pixel cat companion watches over cottagecore hills, barbiecore panels, wand sigil lanes, incoming moon charms, Sparkles score, Vibe Check energy, and “its giving combo” feedback. Use mobile-readable, touch-friendly HUD and CTAs, pixel/comic typography, procedural Canvas art, catalog-approved GIF overlays for reward/fail reactions, and synthesized user-gesture-safe audio tones.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: Four-lane perspective rhythm timing game.
- objective: Tap the horizontal lane matching each incoming note as it reaches the bottom hit pad.
- input model: One pointer/touch/click on the canvas; x-position maps to one of four lanes. Menu buttons use native click/tap.
- core loop: Start run, spawn timed notes from a vanishing point, judge taps with perfect/great/miss windows, update score/combo/energy, continue until energy depletes.
- fail/friction state: Missed notes or late/bad hits reset combo, reduce energy by 15, shake/feedback; energy at or below zero triggers game over and restart.

## Protected Mechanics
- Four lanes, lane selection by tap x-coordinate, and canvas-only gameplay input.
- BPM 130, beat interval `60 / bpm`, travel time `3.0 / (heroSpeed / 5)`, next spawn beat starts at 4.
- Note spawning probabilities: 0.75 beat notes and 0.2 half-beat extra notes during the lookahead loop.
- Hit windows: any candidate within 0.25s; perfect under 0.08s, great under 0.15s, otherwise miss.
- Score and resource semantics: perfect +100/+1 combo/+2 energy, great +50/+1 combo/+1 energy, miss combo reset and -15 energy.
- Game states READY, PLAYING, GAMEOVER and restart behavior.

## Remix Trajectory
The source truth is reinterpreted as a satirical moon-magical rhythm ritual: incoming notes become moon charms, lanes become wand sigils, score becomes Sparkles, energy becomes a Vibe Check, misses are petty cosmic committee drama, and combo becomes “its giving combo.” The implementation preserves the timing and scoring model while replacing the neon relay identity with a pixel/cottage/barbiecore magical-girl meme world.
